end.parentNote: Aditya practised identifying shapes by looking at their faces and matching them with familiar objects, such as a candle, balloon and ball. They correctly described a cylinder as having two flat circular faces. They continued to say that a cone changes its name when turned or placed upside down; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, turn a cone or cylinder in different ways and ask Aditya to name the same shape each time.
